ORDER Date : 20-01-2023 Heard Mr. N. P. Singh, learned counsel for the applicants.

Also heard Mr. K. K.
Parasar, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State respondent.
Page No.# 1/3 vs The State Of Assam

This is an application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, for grant of pre-arrest bail to the accused/applicants, who are apprehending arrest in connection with Hojoi Police Station Case No.504/2022, registered under Sections 379 and 427 of the Indian Penal Code.

In this context Mr. K. K. Parasar, learned Additional Public Prosecutor submits that the accused/applicants has already been charge-sheeted, vide C.S. No. 376/2022 dated 13.12.2022, and hence, the accused/applicants can prefer petitioner before the Trial Court for regular bail.

Mr. N. P. Singh, learned counsel for the applicants submits that as per order dated 30.11.2022, the applicants were already under interim protection and further prays to extend the same, till appearing before the learned Trial Court.

After hearing the submissions of learned counsels of both sides and also considering the fact that the case is already been charge-sheeted, thus, the present applicants are hereby asked to appear before the learned Trial Court Page No.# 3/3 within 15(fifteen) days from today, and the present applicants are directed to file an application for regular bail application.
On filing of such application by the applicants, the learned Trial court shall consider and dispose of the same in accordance with law.
Till then, the pre-arrest bail shall accordingly.
In terms of above, this anticipatory bail application stands disposed of.
